title: core: two cid_for_article fns with incompatible semantics
description: Two functions named cid_for_article exist in crates/core: one in cid_util.rs hashes canonical serialization (sorted fields), one in ipld/cid_util.rs hashes raw wire header_bytes + body_bytes. The ipld version is used for deduplication but both are accessible — using the wrong one silently breaks dedup. The two produce different CIDs for the same article, meaning lookups fail or duplicates are stored undetected.
